info.title: ConCat API Documentation
info.description: Reference for the ConCat `v0` REST API. Requests authenticate with an OAuth access token; see the [OAuth guide](https://concat.app/docs/api/gettingstarted/oauth) for how to get one.

get.description:
Returns the public keys, as an RFC 7517 JWK Set, for verifying the JWTs ConCat signs, such as the bearer token on webhook requests.

### Authentication

This endpoint is not authenticated.

Returns every role defined in the organization. The list isn't paginated, so `hasMore` is always `false`.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:read` scope.

Returns a single user by ID.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:read` scope.

Returns this convention's volunteer departments with their leads. Hidden departments are included; `publiclyVisible` tells them apart. The list isn't paginated.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `volunteer:read` scope.

Returns the user's registration for this convention, or a 404 if they haven't registered. Users can read their own registration without the scope.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `registration:read` scope.

Returns the roles the user holds for this convention, plus their global roles; `scope` says which each one is. Expired role grants are left out. The list isn't paginated, so `hasMore` is always `false`.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:read` scope.

Returns the user's volunteer application for this convention, including their departments, contact methods and option answers, or a 404 if they haven't applied. Users can read their own application without the scope.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `volunteer:read` scope.

put.summary: Grant a role to a user
put.description:
Grants the role to the user. Set `scope` to `global` to grant it for every convention in the organization; otherwise it applies to this convention only. Fails if the user already has the role.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:roles:update` scope.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description:
Removes the role from the user, whether it was granted for this convention or globally. Roles that an automated process manages can't be removed.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:roles:update` scope.

204.description: The role was removed from the user.

400.description: This role is managed by an automated process and cannot be manually removed.

404.description: The user does not have this role.

post.description:
Creates a user account. If you leave out `password`, the account gets a random one; set `sendEmail` to email the user a link to set their own. `reason` is recorded in the audit log. Returns a validation error when a unique field, such as the email address, is already taken.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:create` scope.

Returns this convention's dealers and their applications, ordered by user ID.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `vendor:read` scope.

Returns this convention's orders, ordered by ID, with their items, payments, vouchers and a price breakdown. Cancelled orders are included with the status `cancelled`. Filter by `userId`, by `status`, or by `productId` to only include orders that contain that product.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `order:view` scope.

Returns this convention's registrations, ordered by user ID. Use `userIds` to fetch specific users, or `paidProductId` to only include registrations paid for with that product.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `registration:read` scope.

Returns the organization's users, ordered by ID. Narrow the results with `roleId`, `email` or `ownerUserId` (to list a user's sub-accounts), or use `search` for a free-text search. `search` can't be combined with the other filters.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:read` scope.

Returns this convention's volunteer applications, ordered by ID.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `volunteer:read` scope.

Returns the organization's vouchers, ordered by ID, with the orders each one was applied to. Without a filter, internal-only vouchers are left out; set `voucherIds` to fetch specific vouchers instead.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `order:view` scope.

Returns the IDs of the users who hold the role, either for this convention or globally, ordered by user ID. Expired role grants are left out.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:read` scope.

Returns the notes staff have written about users in the organization, ordered by ID.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:note:read` scope.

Revokes what an item in a paid order granted, along with any free addons of it that haven't been handed out yet. Set `stockReturn` to put the stock back.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `order:manage` scope.

201.description: The order item grant was removed from the order item.

400.description: The order is not yet paid.

404.description: The order item does not exist.

delete.description:
Removes an item from an unpaid order. Paid orders can't be changed, and an addon can't be removed on its own.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `order:manage` scope.

204.description: The order item was removed from the order.

400.description: The order is already marked as paid and the order item can not be removed.

404.description: The order item does not exist.

parentOrderItemId.description: For addons items, the parent item is the product which the addon came from

email.description: An email address to filter by

search.description: A search string to filter by

ownerUserId.description: The ID of the owner user to filter by (sub-accounts owned by this user)

nextPage.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don't include this attribute on the first call. Use the `nextPage` parameter from the previous response for each subsequent request.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return, between 1 and 1000.
